# Calculations for ROI extraction Summary table
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

roi_metadata <- readRDS(
  "results/ROI_extraction/Xen2_KO_Vessels/metadata/Xen2_KO_Vessels_roi_metadata.rds"
)

roi_metadata %>%
  mutate(
    n_cells = purrr::map_int(cell_ids, length)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    experiment_name,
    condition,
    tissue,
    time_point
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rois = n(),
    mean_cells = mean(n_cells),
    sd_cells = sd(n_cells),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

roi_metadata %>%
   mutate(
     n_cells = purrr::map_int(cell_ids, length)
   ) %>%
   group_by(time_point) %>%
   summarise(
     cells_per_roi = paste0(
       round(mean(n_cells)),
       " ± ",
       round(sd(n_cells))
     ),
     .groups = "drop"
   )
```
